title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to graphic for Transmittal No. 20-40 in an earlier arms sales notice (document 2020-18479, originally published August 24, 2020, page 52104).
summary: This Federal Register notice corrects an earlier DSCA arms sales notice (document 2020-18479, published August 24, 2020) because the wrong graphic was printed in error. The correct graphic for Transmittal No. 20-40 is supplied in the correction, but the text itself does not state the country, values, equipment, or contractors for that transmittal.
